messages:
Priya: quick check-in after the RFC comments. proposal is probe-first capability surface + opt-in full manifest. want to confirm ops + security constraints before we ship.
Omar: sounds good. primary concerns: secrets, telemetry continuity, and Dedicated isolation.
Lee: for telemetry we can include endpoints and tags in the probe response instead of full logging hooks. that keeps payload tiny.
Zoe: sketch of probe payload I used in local run:
```json
{
  "capabilities": ["streaming", "kv_cache"],
  "max_seq": 8192,
  "precision": "int8",
  "auth_modes": ["token", "mtls"],
  "feature_versions": {"kv_cache": "v1"},
  "telemetry_endpoint": "https://telemetry.prod.redwood/api/v1/ingest"
}
```
Priya: nice. add a boolean flag `no_secret_proxy: true` by default so adapters cant request secrets unless explicitly enabled.
Omar: +1. for Dedicated customers we should require an explicit consent toggle in the console and log acceptance. also validate DPA for secret proxy enablement.
Lee: migration plan idea: lightweight probe-only mode toggled per-tenant. adapters get a header `X-Redwood-Probe-Version` and return capabilities. runtime maintains fallback to manifest if probe not understood.
Zoe: test coverage: unit for schema, integration test exercising probe-only flow (probe -> route -> model ping), and e2e canary against a small tenant cohort.
infra-bot: created RFC update draft: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026/adapter-capability-probe (added review comments) :white_check_mark:
Priya: rollout order suggestion: internal dev tenants -> free customers -> paid -> enterprise. we gate secret-proxy enabling to enterprise only after DPA check.
Omar: ops checklist: 1) SRE playbook for fallback path 2) logging tag to indicate probe vs manifest routing 3) alert if >1% of requests hit fallback for 24h
Lee: implementation nit: include `compat_fallback=true|false` in probe response so control plane can decide routing without extra RTT.
Zoe: security nit: capability surface must omit any model prompts, example inputs, or customer PII. add that explicitly to the spec.
Priya: agreed. i'm going to update the RFC with the probe schema, privacy constraints, and the three-stage rollout. will ping eng-runtime + eng-platform for review.
Omar: schedule a 30m sync after RFC update? i can join.
Priya: tomorrow 9:30am PT works for me. adding invite.
Lee: i'll start the integration test PR tomorrow morning.
Zoe: i'll draft the canary checklist for SRE and share in #eng-sre.
